text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove...! Um, thank you for the 
present. It arrived at my dorm room this 
morning.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Was running wear alright again this 
year? I considered other options, but 
nothing else felt quite right."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm very happy. Running in new 
athletic wear always feels so special—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Above all, you can never go wrong with Air 
Groove's picks. It's both comfortable and 
breathable—absolutely ideal.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Being praised so wholeheartedly is a 
little embarrassing. But... as long as you 
like it, that's what matters most.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...So, can I ask for just one more 
present?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hm? What is it? Speak up.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, you see... I was wondering if you'd 
come along on my run with my new outfit.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I want to run a lot with you. ...Is that 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Haha, easy peasy! I'll adjust my student 
council duties.
